mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_purchase_list tl LEFT JOIN t_supplier s ON tl.supplier_id = s.id LEFT JOIN t_purchase_list_goods plg ON tl.id = plg.purchase_list_id LEFT JOIN t_goods_type gt ON plg.type_id = gt.id
AND tl.purchase_date >= TO_DATE(#{purchaseListQuery.startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND tl.purchase_date <= TO_DATE(#{purchaseListQuery.endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1
AND ( plg.name LIKE '%' || #{purchaseListQuery.goodsName} || '%' OR plg.code = #{purchaseListQuery.goodsName} )
AND plg.type_id IN
#{typeId}

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT ROWNUM AS rn, t.* FROM ( SELECT tl.purchase_number AS "number", tl.purchase_date AS "date", s.NAME AS "name", plg.code, plg.name AS goodsName, plg.model, plg.unit AS unitName, plg.price, plg.num, plg.total, gt.name AS typeName FROM t_purchase_list tl LEFT JOIN t_supplier s ON tl.supplier_id = s.id LEFT JOIN t_purchase_list_goods plg ON tl.id = plg.purchase_list_id LEFT JOIN t_goods_type gt ON plg.type_id = gt.id
AND tl.purchase_date >= TO_DATE(#{purchaseListQuery.startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND tl.purchase_date <= TO_DATE(#{purchaseListQuery.endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1
AND ( plg.name LIKE '%' || #{purchaseListQuery.goodsName} || '%' OR plg.code = #{purchaseListQuery.goodsName} )
AND plg.type_id IN
#{typeId}
ORDER BY tl.purchase_date DESC ) t
WHERE ROWNUM <= #{purchaseListQuery.endRow} ) WHERE rn > #{purchaseListQuery.startRow}
